Text.Page:
[EN] Hello. I'm Hasmina, from the Mysterium.
[ES] Hola. Soy Hasmina, del Mysterium.

[EN] Anyways, thanks for joining the fight. You're a big help.
[ES] De todos modos, gracias por unirte a la lucha. Eres de gran ayuda.

[EN] I heard Arun isn't so damaged.
[ES] Escuché que Arun no está tan dañado.

[EN] I heard that Northern Shara has already fallen to the Argons.
[ES] Escuché que Northern Shara ya ha caído ante los Argons.

[EN] It used to be so beautiful when I was here with Elleon and the princess.
[ES] Solía ser tan hermoso cuando estuve aquí con Elleon y la princesa.
